about: Human decisions on the reference package, carried into evidence.json human_decisions by scripts/build_reference.py. Add a ruling here; never edit evidence.json by hand.

decisions.decision: Role-to-function bindings for clinic.reference.f: fr.write-check unmapped at layer2b; fr.records to layer1a relational-htap; fr.consent-judge stays layer2c policy-reasoning; fr.workflow unmapped at layer3, fr.reader-model layer2b models, fr.reader-engine layer2b inference-engine and fr.compute layer0a deskside as drafted; the five authority bindings and the layer accounting approved as drafted.
decisions.reason: tool-execution is defined as vendor-side and the reference's tools are the bench's own code; the records requirement is a transactional system of record; policy-reasoning describes the 2C decision Lab 029 placed there and grants the driver's host no grade.

decisions.decision: Typed links (handoff v1.1) for clinic.reference.f, as proposed: binding.workflow rests on fr.workflow; binding.consent and binding.selfpay-willing on fr.consent-judge; binding.write-check on fr.write-check and fr.records; binding.selfpay-claim-ceiling carries no list because nothing enforces it.
decisions.reason: Each binding should rest on the functions that make its decision, not on every function its implementer happens to implement. Under F the reader's yes never commits consent, so the reader stays out of the consent list and is reached through the consent judge's dependency on it.
